sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
In ancient history, Ammit Heart-Eater inspired the Egyptian mythology surrounding Ammit, a crocodile goddess that devoured the hearts of people whose hearts were heavier than the Feather Of Truth in the afterlife. She instilled a heightened fear of the Nile crocodiles that would attack Egyptians and their boats. {{source|Huntik.com/Secret Files}}

At one point, [[Eathon Lambert]] faced one or multiple Ammit Heart-Eater Titans, noting on [[Eathon Lambert's journal|his journal]] that it is better to run away then to face their teeth.  {{Source|TCG:OAL-050|OAL-050}}

sections.heading: Suit 030's Ammit Heart-Eater
sections.wikitext: Ammit Heart-Eater later became one of the more powerful Titans owned by [[the Organization]]. Their [[Amulets]] were given to many of the high-ranking [[Suits]], including an archaeologist working for [[Klaus]]. At a dig for the lost [[Tomb of Nefertiti]], Ammit was invoked to attack [[Dante Vale]]'s team but was defeated by [[Caliban]]. {{source|All Work and No Pay}} The Titan again was invoked within the tomb. It was fought [[Icarus]] and Caliban before being stunned by a double [[Touchram]] from [[Zhalia Moon]] and Dante. {{source|The Sceptre Deception}}

sections.heading: Suit 042's Ammit Heart-Eater
sections.wikitext:
One of Rassimov's Suits invoked Ammit Heart-Eater in an alleyway in [[Paris, France]] where it fought alongside [[Jokoul]] against both Lok and Dante's [[Freelancer]]s. Another Ammit Heart-Eater was later defeated by the traps in the [[Mausoleum of Sir Lancelot]]. {{source|Memory Lane}}

This Suit later summoned Ammit Heart-Eater in [[King Solomon's mines]] where it was defeated by Dante's [[Caliban]]. {{source|To Be Together}}

sections.heading: Rassimov's Ammit Heart-Eater
sections.text:
One Amulet was also present in the arsenal of Rassimov, and he treated her like a pet and would not hesitate to summon her to fight against the Huntik Foundation. [TCG:SAS-025]

Rassimov summoned Ammit Heart-Eater against Dante Vale on the bridge of the Professor's castle. She was knocked off the bridge by Caliban and left unconscious before waking up and delaying Lok, Sophie and Zhalia from joining Dante. [The Divine Comedy]

Ammit was later unbonded from Rassimov by Dante's Sorrowbond and locked away in a box with his other Titans and taken back to the Huntik Foundation. [Rassimov's Secret]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
Ammit can bite and crush her enemies with her razor sharp teeth and powerful jaws as well as use her hefty tail to smash enemies. She can easily destroy a car {{Source|TCG:OAL-050|OAL-050}} and has been shown to be strong enough to hold her own in a tussle with the powerful [[Metagolem]] before defeating him with assistance. {{source|The Sceptre Deception}}

full_text:
Ammit Heart-Eater is a Hecto-Titan that resembles a blue-skinned crocodile, dressed in golden armor and a teal robe. Her sharp teeth make her a fearsome Titan and is thus often called upon by members of the Organization in battle.

History

In ancient history, Ammit Heart-Eater inspired the Egyptian mythology surrounding Ammit, a crocodile goddess that devoured the hearts of people whose hearts were heavier than the Feather Of Truth in the afterlife. She instilled a heightened fear of the Nile crocodiles that would attack Egyptians and their boats. [Huntik.com/Secret Files]

At one point, Eathon Lambert faced one or multiple Ammit Heart-Eater Titans, noting on his journal that it is better to run away then to face their teeth.  [OAL-050]

Suit 030's Ammit Heart-Eater

Ammit Heart-Eater later became one of the more powerful Titans owned by the Organization. Their Amulets were given to many of the high-ranking Suits, including an archaeologist working for Klaus. At a dig for the lost Tomb of Nefertiti, Ammit was invoked to attack Dante Vale's team but was defeated by Caliban. [All Work and No Pay] The Titan again was invoked within the tomb. It was fought Icarus and Caliban before being stunned by a double Touchram from Zhalia Moon and Dante. [The Sceptre Deception]

Klaus' Ammit Heart-Eater

In Klaus' bookshop, Klaus invoked his Ammit Heart-Eater to attack Dante Vale but was tussled by Metagolem. After Klaus's Nighlurker attacked Metagolem, Ammit was able to defeat him with a tail swipe. It then fought Lok Lambert's Freelancer before being defeated. [The Bookshop Hunter]

Suit 042's Ammit Heart-Eater

One of Rassimov's Suits invoked Ammit Heart-Eater in an alleyway in Paris, France where it fought alongside Jokoul against both Lok and Dante's Freelancers. Another Ammit Heart-Eater was later defeated by the traps in the Mausoleum of Sir Lancelot. [Memory Lane]

This Suit later summoned Ammit Heart-Eater in King Solomon's mines where it was defeated by Dante's Caliban. [To Be Together]

Suit 040's Ammit Heart-Eater

Ammit was invoked by one of Rassimov's Suits in Turkey alongside Bonelasher but both were swiftly defeated by Lok's Lindorm. [Ladies' Choice]

This Suit later invoked Ammit Heart-Eater down in Atlantis. [Coming of Age]

Rassimov's Ammit Heart-Eater

One Amulet was also present in the arsenal of Rassimov, and he treated her like a pet and would not hesitate to summon her to fight against the Huntik Foundation. [TCG:SAS-025]

Rassimov summoned Ammit Heart-Eater against Dante Vale on the bridge of the Professor's castle. She was knocked off the bridge by Caliban and left unconscious before waking up and delaying Lok, Sophie and Zhalia from joining Dante. [The Divine Comedy]

Ammit was later unbonded from Rassimov by Dante's Sorrowbond and locked away in a box with his other Titans and taken back to the Huntik Foundation. [Rassimov's Secret]

Suit 025's Ammit Heart-Eater

One of Klaus' Suits attempted to invoke Ammit Heart-Eater against Harrison Fears outside the Tomb of Nefertiti but he was completely ensnared by Rassimov's Thornment. [Rassimov's Secret]

Abilities

Ammit can bite and crush her enemies with her razor sharp teeth and powerful jaws as well as use her hefty tail to smash enemies. She can easily destroy a car [OAL-050] and has been shown to be strong enough to hold her own in a tussle with the powerful Metagolem before defeating him with assistance. [The Sceptre Deception]

• Ammit's summoning commands is "Shred them".
• Ammit is based off Ammit, the Devourer of the Dead, who was also a crocodile, that ate hearts of the ones whose hearts were heavier than a feather, which is where the "Heart-Eater" part of the title comes from.
